name: Arcanist Divinist
body:
A divinist is a strange sort of spellcaster; as a philosopher, she gains divine power by her own studies about how the rapports between mortals and gods work, rather than being chosen by one or more deities as their agent.

Divine Spellcasting

A divinist is a divine spellcaster and uses the cleric/oracle spell list instead of the wizard/sorcerer spell list. The divinist uses her Wisdom score, rather than her Intelligence score, to determine which levels of spells she can cast, her spells’ save DC, and how many spells she can cast per day. However, she has not automatically access to every spell in her list, as a legendary cleric. Rather, she must learn spells and transcribe them into her prayer book. She can’t prepare any spell not recorded in her prayer book, except for read magic (which all arcanists can prepare from memory).

A divinist begins play with a prayer book containing all 0-level cleric/oracle spells plus three 1st-level spells of her choice.

The divinist also selects a number of additional 1st-level spells equal to her Wisdom modifier to add to the prayer book. At each new level, she gains two new spells of any spell level or 5 levels that she can cast (based on her new arcanist level) for her prayer book. At any time, a divinist can also add spells found in scrolls, divine spellbooks, or other divinists’ prayer books to her own (see Divine Magical Writings).This ability alters the spells and spellbooks class features.

Orisons: A divinist can prepare a number of orisons, or 0-level divine spells, each day as per the arcanist’s spells prepared table. These spells are cast like any other spell, but they do not consume spell slots. As with her other spells, these spells are not expended when cast.

Exploits: A divinist has no access to the following exploits: arcane discovery, bloodline development, familiar, school understanding.

A divinist gains access to the following arcanist exploits:

Divine Tampering (Ex)

Sometimes the deities feel disturbed by someone borrowing their power without permission.

The divinist chooses one oracle curse, using her character level as his effective oracle level when determining the effects of this curse. If an oracle curse would add spells to the oracle’s list of spells known, the divinist instead adds those spells to her spell list as well as to her prayer book.

Domain Meditation: The divinist can select one deity with an alignment within one step of her own, and one cleric domain that deity grants (druidic domains included).

The divinist gains one domain power as though she were a 1st-level cleric, using her Charisma modifier in place of her Wisdom modifier for this power. The power must be one gained at 1st level and is limited in its use per day to 3 + the divinist’s Charisma modifier. As a swift action, the divinist can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to bolster her meditation, allowing her to treat her arcanist level as her cleric level for the purpose of using this power for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). During this time, she also gains use of any other abilities gained at 1st level for her selected domain (except for domain-granted familiars). She does not gain any other abilities when using this exploit in this way, such as those gained at 8th level. If the divinist already has access to domains (or gains it later), taking this exploit instead allows her arcanist levels to stack with the levels of the class that granted them when determining the powers and abilities of her domains.

Mysteric Initiation: The divinist selects one oracle mystery upon taking this exploit. The divinist gains one revelation from that mystery as though she were a 1st-level oracle. As a swift action, the divinist can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to bolster her latent connection to divine forces, allowing her to treat her level as her oracle level for the purpose of using this ability, which lasts for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1). She does not gain any other abilities when using this exploit in this way, such as an oracle’s curse. If the arcanist already has access to revelations (or gains it later), taking this exploit instead allows her arcanist levels to stack with the levels of the class that granted her access to revelations when determining the powers and abilities of her revelations.

Personalized Channel (Su)

The divinist selects one feat that alters the channel energy ability to gain as a bonus feat.

She can channel energy as a 1st-level cleric only to use the selected feat. As a swift action, the divinist can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to treat her level as her cleric level for the purpose of using this ability for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

The divinist can take other feats to add to this ability, such as Improved Channeling, but not feats that alter this ability, such as Alignment Channel.

Spirit Animal (Ex)

A divinist with this exploit can acquire a spirit animal as the shaman class feature, using her class level as her shaman level to determine any of the statistics and abilities of the spirit animal. The divinist must select one shaman spirit upon taking this exploit; her spirit animal gains the ability of that spirit. If the divinist receives a spirit animal or familiar from another class, her levels stack with the levels from that class when determining the spirit animal’s statistics and abilities.

Spiritual Contract (Ex)

The divinist can strike a temporary pact with spirits. She gains the Spirit Talker feat as a bonus feat and can use the granted hex as a shaman or witch of her same level, even if she has no access to hexes from other sources. She must meet the level prerequisites of the feat.
